_doc: No Law, beat 3 (docs/missions/no-law.md; issue #773): the red shirt (Cody, the Baron's hired gun, the man who shot the sheriff) walks into the saloon's yard at night, accuses Earl of dealing from the bottom, kicks his chair out from under him (the card cheat's kick, CardCheat), draws, shoots him in the head where he lies, says there's no law to save him now and walks out. A stranger sits down in the free chair a minute before and tells you not to move; sat at the table you're held there (PlayerSeat.hold) and the game with you (CardGame.interrupt(&"red_shirt", true)). The room goes quiet (the folk hushed, CivilianBrain.hush) till the barman: "Jesus, Cody, my chair!". After: you're let go, Earl's body stays, the drifter and the miner leave, the stranger has his word and goes. Started by ValleyFolk at `hour` on the first night (StoryState has no nolaw.murder yet), or sooner once you've played `after_hands` hands at the table (from `earliest` on); the bridge's `moment no_law_murder` starts it now. `-- --no-murder`: the valley's nights without it. Sean (chat, 2026-11-09): sat at the table with no gun, "so he can't do anything at all"; "the stranger sits there and tells the character not to do anything"; "card cheat shot in the head"; the barman's first words "Jesus, Cody, my chair!".
